territorial_scope.description: Applies to AI scientific and technology activities carried out within the territory of China; provincial-level and sectoral authorities supervise within their remits.

evidence.quote: 是在中华人民共和国境内开展的

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Requires ethics review of AI scientific research and technology development in China. Research bodies and enterprises must establish ethics committees or use review centres; activities follow general, simplified or emergency procedures; listed activities need expert re-review; records go to a national platform. Effective from 20 March 2026.
summary.long: The Measures require ethics review of AI scientific research and technology development in China that may affect human dignity, public order, life and health, ecology or sustainable development (Arts 1-2). Universities, research institutes, medical institutions and enterprises must set up ethics committees or apply to an entrusted service centre (Arts 9-12). Applications must include a plan, a risk assessment and a written pledge. Reviews assess human welfare, fairness and bias prevention, robustness, transparency and explainability, traceability and privacy (Art 15). Decisions are due within 30 days of acceptance (Art 16). General, simplified (Art 19) and emergency procedures (72 hours, Art 27) apply by risk level. Listed activities, including human-machine fusion systems, opinion-mobilising algorithms and highly autonomous automated decision systems, require expert re-review (Arts 21-25, Annex). Ongoing activities are tracked at intervals of up to 12 months, or 6 for listed activities (Arts 17, 25). Ministries and local authorities supervise, and records are filed on a national platform (Arts 29-30). Violations are handled under the Cybersecurity, Data Security and Personal Information Protection laws; no penalty amounts are set (Art 32). Standards, services, research and training are encouraged (Arts 4-8). The Measures take effect on issue, 20 March 2026 (Art 37).

notes: Issued by MIIT and nine other ministries per the header (工信部联科〔2026〕75号, 2026年3月20日); trial measures (试行); in force on issuance (Art. 37). The 《伦理办法》 is cited throughout but its text is not in this document. No amendment or repeal relations are stated. Time limits: Art. 33 says deadlines not marked as working days are calendar days, while Art. 16 expressly marks 3 and 7 working days for appeals. Art. 26 exempts certain AI activities from expert re-review where registration, filing or approval regimes for deep synthesis, algorithmic recommendation or generative AI apply; those regimes are not identified by name here. Named target instruments are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty.

obligations.summary: Article 3 states that persons conducting AI scientific and technology activities shall apply ethics requirements throughout the whole process, following listed ethical principles. The addressee is implied (activity conductors); the article is a principle statement with an identifiable conduct.

evidence.quote: 开展人工智能科技活动应将科技伦理要求贯穿全过程

obligations.summary: Article 4 states that the standard system for AI technology ethics shall be established and improved, and that standards be formulated; the subject is not named in the clause. Encouragement of participation by universities, research and medical institutions, enterprises and social organisations in standard-making is a separate encouraged conduct (see the same article).

evidence.quote: 建立和完善人工智能科技伦理标准体系

obligations.summary: Universities, research institutions, medical and health institutions, enterprises and science associations are encouraged to participate in formulating, verifying and promoting AI ethics standards.

evidence.quote: 参与人工智能科技伦理标准的制定

obligations.summary: Article 5 requires advancing the AI ethics service system (risk monitoring, assessment, certification, consultancy) and increased support and services for review by micro, small and medium enterprises; the subject is not named.

evidence.quote: 加大对中小微企业人工智能科技伦理审查的支持

obligations.summary: Entities listed are encouraged to carry out AI ethics review research, support technical innovation in review, open high-quality datasets, develop risk management and audit tools, and promote ethically compliant AI products and services.

evidence.quote: 开展人工智能科技伦理审查研究

obligations.summary: Article 7 requires AI ethics publicity and education (subject not named), with public participation encouraged and mass media guided to carry such education.

obligations.summary: Universities, research institutions, medical institutions and enterprises are encouraged to carry out AI ethics education and training and to develop talent.

evidence.quote: 开展人工智能科技伦理相关教育与培训

obligations.summary: Responsible entities (universities, research institutions, medical institutions, enterprises) shall establish an AI ethics committee under the Ethics Measures' Article 4, provide it with staff, premises and funds, and take measures to guarantee its independence. Certification of the ethics management system is encouraged.

evidence.quote: 应按照《伦理办法》第四条有关要求

obligations.summary: The committee's charter, composition and members' duties follow Articles 5 to 8 of the Ethics Measures; the committee shall include experts in AI technology, application, ethics and law.

obligations.summary: A service centre shall not provide both review and re-review services for the same AI scientific and technology activity.

obligations.summary: Service centres shall establish standardised management rules and procedures, have full-time staff with AI ethics review capability, and accept supervision by local or competent authorities.

evidence.quote: 服务中心应建立规范的管理制度和程序

obligations.summary: The leader of an AI activity shall apply to the unit's committee (or an entrusted service centre where no committee exists) and submit application materials: activity plan, ethics risk assessment and response plan, and a written commitment to comply with ethics and research integrity requirements.
obligations.conditional_on: Activities within the scope of Art. 2

evidence.quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应向本单位委员会申请

obligations.summary: Application materials must include an assessment of potential ethics risks from the planned AI application, monitoring and early-warning measures, and prevention and control plans; this is listed among the application materials in Art. 12(2).
obligations.conditional_on: Activities within the scope of Art. 2

evidence.quote: 潜在科技伦理风险评估

obligations.summary: The committee or service centre decides whether to accept an application and notifies the applicant; on acceptance it specifies the general, simplified or emergency procedure; where materials are incomplete it must inform the applicant of all missing materials in one notice.

evidence.quote: 材料不齐全的应一次性完整告知需补充的材料

obligations.summary: Ethics review meetings are chaired by the committee director or designated deputy and require at least 5 attending members including members of the different categories in Art. 10; non-conflicted advisory experts may be consulted but do not vote.

evidence.quote: 到会委员应不少于 5 人

obligations.summary: Review focuses on human welfare, fairness and justice (including bias prevention), controllability and trustworthiness, transparency and explainability, accountability and traceability, and privacy protection.

evidence.quote: 重点关注以下方面

obligations.summary: Decision within 30 days after acceptance (extension possible in complex cases) on approval, re-review after modification, or refusal; for modification or refusal, the committee shall give suggestions or reasons. Applicants may appeal within 3 working days, and the committee re-decides within 7 working days if the appeal has sufficient grounds.

evidence.quote: 应在申请受理后的 30 日内

obligations.summary: The simplified procedure may be used where (1) ethics risk is no higher than ordinary daily-life risk, (2) a minor change is made to an approved plan without raising the risk-benefit ratio, or (3) follow-up review of an activity with no major adjustment.

evidence.quote: 委员会或服务中心应制定适用简易程序审查的工作规程和跟踪频度

evidence.quote: 由本单位申请开展专家复核

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff found that changes scope, eligibility, exemption, obligation tier, prohibition, benefit or penalty. Numbers present are procedural time limits (e.g. 30 days in Art. 16 and Art. 23; 72 and 36 hours in Art. 27), review intervals (Art. 17, 25), and a meeting quorum of 5 members (Art. 14), none coded as thresholds under the codebook. Art. 5 refers to 中小微企业 for support without a size test in the text.
